findings.evidence: Lines 117-120 and 126-131 have the same structure, differing only in `T`/`S`, `j`/`k` and `hij`/`hik`; both write out `(F := fun i ↦ B i ⊗[A] _) (fun i j h ↦ rTensor (R := A) _ (f i j h))`.
findings.fix: Add a private lemma: if `(rTensor X (f i j hij)).comp g = (rTensor X (f i j hij)).comp h` and `j ≤ l`, then the same equation holds with `f i l`. Apply it at `X := T` and `X := S`, so the `map_map'` rewrite with explicit `F :=` is written once.
findings.issue: `hlT` and `hlS` duplicate the same argument: apply `congrArg (rTensor _ (f _ l _))`, then `simp only`, then rewrite with `DirectedSystem.map_map'` on a hand-written tensor directed system, then `simpa`. This hides a reusable fact (an equalized pair stays equal at every later stage).

findings.evidence: Line 67: `simpa [Ψ, Algebra.smul_def, -DirectLimit.Algebra.of_apply] using e.symm.commutes ...`; line 92: `simpa [-DirectLimit.Algebra.of_apply] using hs.symm`; line 131: `simpa [Ψl, ψl] using hs`.
findings.fix: Replace each with a `simp only [AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, includeRight_apply, map_tmul, ...]` listing the lemmas it actually uses, or factor the shared step (e.g. the value of `liftEquiv` on `1 ⊗ₜ t`) into a named lemma.
findings.issue: Bare `simpa [..., -DirectLimit.Algebra.of_apply]` / `simpa [Ψl, ψl]` / `simpa using` calls close goals by unfolding `liftEquiv`, `includeRight` and tensor maps under the full simp set. Excluding `of_apply` by hand shows the proofs depend on the simp-set shape and would break on Mathlib simp-lemma changes. Other instances: lines 69, 92, 131, 134, 137.

summary: The proofs are under 50 lines but repeat the same stage-lifting reasoning twice instead of factoring it out, and several unscoped `simpa` calls close non-obvious goals by unfolding `liftEquiv`/tensor maps with hand-tuned simp-set exclusions.
